actualOriginalFindings.evidence: 女じょ 1344940.1 explicitly has standalone noun daughter as well as suffix use; the new caption contains дочь. 兄けい 2200990.1 is a familiar male-address pronoun in letters, matching ты (фамильярное обращение) for a male friend/equal, not its superior-address use or separate Mr suffix.
